title: Malachi Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Malachi 2: the warning to the priests, the covenant with Levi, and dealing treacherously against the wife of your youth.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do if the priests will not take it to heart to give glory to his name?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:2 says he will send the curse on them and will curse their blessings, and that he has cursed them already.

answers.text: Remove them from the land of their fathers
Shut the doors of the temple against them
Send the curse on them and curse their blessings
Hand them over to the people of Edom

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will spread on their faces?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:3 says he will rebuke their offspring and spread dung on their faces, even the dung of their feasts.

questions.text: What was the covenant Yahweh made with Levi a covenant of?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:5 says his covenant with him was of life and peace, so that he might be reverent toward Yahweh.

questions.text: What does verse 7 say the priest is?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:7 says the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and that he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

answers.text: The messenger of Yahweh of Armies
The keeper of the temple gates

questions.text: What does Yahweh accuse the priests of doing to the covenant of Levi?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:8 says they have turned away from the path, caused many to stumble in the law, and corrupted the covenant of Levi.

answers.text: Reading it only at the feasts
Writing it again in their own words

questions.text: What abomination is Judah said to have committed?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:11 says Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

answers.text: Marrying the daughter of a foreign god
Building an altar on a mountain
Selling the vessels of the temple

questions.text: With what do they cover Yahweh's altar?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:13 says they cover Yahweh's altar with tears, with weeping and with sighing, because he no longer regards the offering.

questions.text: Between whom has Yahweh been a witness?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:14 says Yahweh has been witness between the man and the wife of his youth, against whom he has dealt treacherously.

answers.text: Between the priest and the king
Between a man and the wife of his youth
Between the rich and the poor

questions.text: What does verse 15 say God sought when he made them one?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:15 asks why he made them one, and answers that he sought godly offspring.

questions.text: How have they wearied Yahweh, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: Malachi 2:17 says they have wearied Yahweh with their words by saying that everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh's sight and that he delights in them.

answers.text: By bringing no offerings at all to his altar
By following prophets who were never sent
With their words, calling the evildoer good in Yahweh's sight
By keeping the feasts carelessly, year after year
